crossRefs.note: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of…
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

people.name: Beth-arabah
people.line: Town and wilderness area in Judah, also associated with Benjamin.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Zemaraim
people.line: A town in Benjamin; also a hill in Ephraim

translations.kjv: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
translations.asv: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,
